_comment: EXPERIMENT B ONLY - isolated experimental approval manifest. It models a compromised supplier releasing an update that the consumer then explicitly approves as a new authentic version: it approves the digest of the malicious fixture wheel (packages/exportkit-malicious/dist). It is used only by scripts/experiment_b.py and is never read by the normal build, the Dockerfile defaults, Jenkins or the tests. The real manifest is manifest/approved_packages.json.
